pairs.v1_problem: authorial diagnosis explains Ma Qing's coordination fatigue and the ending gives a neat miniature resolution
v2_changes: removed explicit paragraph diagnosing why Ma Qing is annoyed
added meeting interruption and version-management noise
kept Song Nan and Ma Qing partly misaligned instead of fully mutually understanding
ended on Ma Qing moving into the next meeting rather than a designed symbolic slide-title change
what_improved: Ma Qing's independent workday is more legible
institutional pressure appears through time, people and file versions rather than explanation
Song Nan remains an important collaborator without taking over the scene
the guest micro-arc survives even though it is less explicitly resolved
what_was_lost: v1 made the learning point about statistical uncertainty slightly clearer
v2 asks the reader to infer more from procedural action
pairs.remaining_risk: dialogue still moves relatively efficiently because all participants are professionally trained and the scene is task-focused

pairs.v1_problem: narrator explains communication theory and He Xin's desired boundary too completely
v2_changes: removed the full paragraph explaining exactly what He Xin wants from her brother
made the quarrel less rhetorically balanced
reduced repair to short messages and retained continued private housing browsing
what_improved: He Xin can be skilled at communication and still fail to communicate without narrative contradiction
the brother remains helpful, intrusive and understandable at the same time
family-origin pressure is visible through role expectation rather than backstory exposition
the reader must infer why 'you always do this' is heavier than the housing link itself
what_was_lost: v1 made the exact nature of He Xin's boundary conflict easier to decode immediately
pairs.remaining_risk: the brother's line about her words being precise but painful is slightly crafted and should not become a recurring self-aware formulation

pairs.v1_problem: mirrored questions create formal symmetry and the look-back ending gives an unnecessary cinematic signal
v2_changes: allowed one topic to end after a single acknowledgement
used the power-strip question as ordinary continuation rather than symbolic ending
what_improved: information exchange is partial and inefficient
characters do not extract a lesson from the meal
mundane expertise appears naturally in Zhou Ye without turning into character demonstration
what_was_lost: v1 had a slightly cleaner sense of both characters independently valuing stable time and transferable work
pairs.remaining_risk: the final sentence 'this time they really separated' is still an authorial nudge and should probably be removed in any later version

cross_pair_findings.main_result: Removing explicit interpretation increases character legibility rather than reducing it when the ledger and character model are already strong.
cross_pair_findings.narrative_distance_candidate: close but externally anchored realism: selective interior access, concrete procedural/material detail, limited narrator diagnosis, no mandatory scene resolution
do_not_overcorrect: awkwardness should not become a new style gimmick
educated professionals can sometimes communicate efficiently
some scenes need explicit decisions and procedural clarity
withholding explanation cannot become deliberate obscurity

next_recommendation: Use the emerging restrained narrative distance in one sustained 1800-3000 Chinese-character scene. The long-scene test should contain at least three people, an institutional task, a minor misunderstanding, dead time, and no final thematic resolution. If the voice survives length without reverting to explanation or decorative sensitivity, allow a provisional narrative-voice canon while keeping scene text disposable.
